# Fixture Rejections and Missing Evidence

- No locally available real non-plant image had sufficiently explicit licence
  and provenance for acceptance. Programmatic non-plant-like images are not a
  substitute.
- Duplicate-review montage images were rejected because they are generated
  composites rather than original runtime inputs.
- Provisional-test and sealed-test images were excluded without inspection.
- Calibration images were not used because development-validation records were
  sufficient for the limited routing fixtures.
- Dataset images without a manifest hash match were rejected.
- Dataset folder labels alone were rejected as proof of disease correctness.
- No fixtures were accepted as proven coverage of varied lighting, background,
  partial leaves, multiple leaves, or moderate blur.
